name: UmmahAPI
description: Comprehensive all-in-one Islamic REST API providing prayer times with 23 calculation methods, complete Quran text and audio (12 translations, 12 reciters), Hadith collections, Qibla compass bearing, Hijri calendar, Duas, 99 Names of Allah, Tafsir, Zakat calculator, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) support. Free with no signup required for anonymous requests.

authentication.description: Anonymous requests require no key or signup. Free API keys can be requested for higher rate limits and passed via header or query parameter.

rateLimit.authenticated: Higher limits available with free API key

features: Prayer times with 23 astronomical calculation methods & high latitude rules
Quran text, translations, word-by-word analysis, transliteration, and audio recitations
Hadith collections (tens of thousands of hadiths including Sahih al-Bukhari)
Hijri calendar conversions and moon sighting calculations
Authentic Duas categorized into 27 life occasions
99 Names of Allah (Asma ul-Husna) with meanings and transliteration
Tafsir commentaries (Ibn Kathir, Ma'arif al-Qur'an, Muyassar)
Dynamic Zakat calculator based on current gold/silver Nisab
Model Context Protocol (MCP) endpoint for AI agents

endpoints.name: Get Today Prayer Times
endpoints.description: Returns prayer times (Fajr, Sunrise, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha) for the specified coordinates.

parameters.name: method
parameters.description: Calculation method (e.g. MuslimWorldLeague, NorthAmerica, Egyptian, UmmAlQura, Algeria)

endpoints.name: Get Month Prayer Times Schedule
endpoints.description: Returns the entire month schedule of prayer times.

endpoints.name: Get Calculation Methods
endpoints.description: Lists all 23 calculation methods, parameters, and juristic options.

data.name: Algerian Ministry of Religious Affairs and Wakfs
data.description: Algerian Ministry of Religious Affairs and Wakfs. Uses standard Fajr angle of 18° and Isha angle of 17°.

endpoints.name: Get Ramadan Timetable
endpoints.description: Retrieves the full Ramadan fasting and prayer timetable for a given year and location.

endpoints.name: Get Qibla Direction
endpoints.description: Calculates the exact compass bearing towards the Kaaba (Makkah) from coordinates.

endpoints.name: Get Today Hijri Date
endpoints.description: Fetches current Gregorian date, corresponding Hijri date, month details, and Islamic context.

endpoints.name: List All Surahs
endpoints.description: Returns metadata for all 114 Quran chapters (verses count, revelation type, titles, translations).

endpoints.name: Get Complete Surah
endpoints.description: Retrieves the full surah text in Arabic with transliteration, translation, and audio URLs.

endpoints.name: Get Single Ayah
endpoints.description: Retrieves a single verse by surah number and ayah number.

endpoints.name: Word-by-Word Breakdown
endpoints.description: Provides morphology and word-by-word Arabic text, transliteration, and english translation.

endpoints.name: Search Quran
endpoints.description: Search the Quran across Arabic script or translations.

endpoints.name: Get Hadith by Number
endpoints.description: Fetches a specific Hadith from canonical collections.

endpoints.name: Get Duas & Categories
endpoints.description: Retrieves supplications from authentic Sunnah across 27 life categories.

endpoints.name: Get Random Dua
endpoints.description: Fetches a random supplication with Arabic text, transliteration, English meaning, and reference.

endpoints.name: Get 99 Names of Allah
endpoints.description: Returns all 99 Names of Allah (Asma ul Husna) with Arabic font, transliteration, and English meanings.

endpoints.name: Get Single Name of Allah
endpoints.description: Fetches a specific divine name by its rank (1-99).

endpoints.name: Calculate Zakat
endpoints.description: Calculates obligatory Zakat on cash, gold, silver, investments, and business inventory against active Nisab standards.

mcpEndpoint.description: Model Context Protocol endpoint for connecting AI coding assistants (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, Antigravity) directly to authenticated Islamic data.
